title: Even if there were a replacement,
paragraphs: Wow! Father turned down Filo-tan’s request! Did he actually manage to withstand the cry from the depths of Filo-tan’s soul!? What incredible mental strength! I caught a glimpse of the profound, bottomless reserve of power that the Shield Hero possesses. That’s Father for you.
“Master—!”

“I’ve indulged your whims quite a bit today, haven’t I! Filo, you’re saying you can’t trust Raphtalia as an older sister, aren’t you? That kind of selfishness won’t do you any good. I know it might sound strange coming from me, but you need to trust Raphtalia.”
“No way!”
Hearing Filo-tan’s refusal, her older sister is at a loss for words. Why doesn’t Filo-tan trust her older sister?
“……Motoyasu, this is an order. Restrain Filo or put her to sleep.”
What a cruel order this is! Are you really asking me to do something like that, Father?
“B-but—”
“Motoyasu, is this so-called ‘love’ of yours just pampering? If you don’t be strict sometimes, she’ll grow up to be spoiled, and nothing good will come of it. That wouldn’t be good for Filo either.”

Come to think of it, I feel like my Older Sister from the first world said something similar to me before. Although her words were harsh, what Father said was absolutely correct. It’s true that in previous loops, there were children like Kou who acted selfishly. I’ve also heard that Kuro-chan, who turned into Black Thunder, received some “educational guidance” from the great Filolial-sama. So Father’s words aren’t wrong.
“O… okay. I’m really sorry, Filo-tan. But this is all for your own good, you know.”
The Older Sister is looking at us with a slightly exasperated expression. I’m sure it’s just my imagination.
“No, no! What are you doing to Filo!? Master, help me!”
Father has a very stern look on his face. He’s probably steeled his heart to teach Filo-tan about love. However, this situation… it’s giving me chills.
…Hah! That’s a dangerous sign. For some reason, my first-world Father has appeared in my mind, saying, “He managed to control himself…,” but now is not the time for that.
“Well then, Filo-tan, I’ll apologize first! I’m so sorry, Sleep Lance V!”

I gave Filo-tan a slight poke with the tip of my lance. Filo-chan! I’ve hurt you, even just a little. Ugh… my heart feels like it’s about to burst. I’ll spend my entire life atoning for this sin, so please bear with it for now.
“Y-yeah… Filo is… with Master… zzz…”
With a thud, Filo-tan drifted off into the world of dreams.
“If you’ve been a good girl and watched the house, I’ll at least bring you back a souvenir. Make sure you watch the house properly tonight, okay?”
Muttering that, Father gently stroked Filo-tan’s cheek.
“That was… a truly heart-wrenching experience, wasn’t it?”
“That said, I can’t have you acting all selfish just because you can’t trust even Raphtalia.”
“I suppose I can sort of understand how she feels, though…”
“Raphtalia, keep an eye on Filo… and Motoyasu for me.”
“Yes. I’ll do my best to become a big sister whom Filo can trust.”
“I’m counting on you. But… isn’t forcing a whining child to stay behind so you can go to the tavern pretty despicable?”

Muttering things like that, Father headed out. Soon, a quiet silence began to settle between me and Big Sister. ……That’s right. To strengthen my bond with Big Sister, I need to communicate with her. After all, the efforts you put in now will pay off later on.
“Until Father returns, I, Motoyasu, will definitely protect both Filo-tan and Big Sister.”
“O-okay, I’m counting on you.”

After making that vow… my gaze became fixed on Filo-tan’s sleeping face as she drifted off peacefully. Heh heh heh, heh heh heh heh… I never get tired of looking at Filo-tan’s sleeping face. I think I could watch her like this for years, or even hundreds of years. She’s truly a Sleeping Beauty, isn’t she?
“That kind of attitude…”
“Big Sister, what’s wrong with my attitude?”
“No, I just thought Filo would feel more at ease if you were a little calmer.”
“I see! I’ll do my best to become a more composed man!”

That must be an important thing to keep in mind when dating Filo-tan. Come to think of it, I’ve heard that even on modern-day Earth, calm, older men tend to be popular with women. Just as I expected from Filo-tan’s Older Sister! Following her advice, I’ll make a point of behaving more calmly from now on.

Before long, my gaze drifted toward Filo-tan’s skirt. From this angle, if I crouched down just a little more, I might be able to see inside. No, but… doing something so dishonest… no, just a little more… just a little more… Just as I was wrestling with these thoughts, the Older Sister spoke quietly.
“…Spear Hero.”
Whoa. No, that’s not it at all. It’s just that my love got a little out of hand. Even if I did happen to see something, I wouldn’t do anything beyond that. I’m not that much Trash!
“W-what is it?”
“You said you came from the future, didn’t you?”
Oh? Does that mean she’s not calling me out on my wicked impulses? Well, I’ll just answer her question honestly for now.
“Yes, I did.”
“In that future… were we… happy?”
Happy, you ask? As she asked that, images of my future fathers popped into my head.
“Of course.”
No matter who tries to deny it, I’ll nod in agreement on this point alone. After all, it’s a peaceful world we achieved together with Fathers.
“So… Naofumi-sama, once the Wave ended… did you go back?”
My Older Sister asks me this with a rather serious look in her eyes.
“At least as far as I can remember, Father didn’t go back.”

I believe he stayed in this world long after the Wave ended. After the Wave receded, he seemed quite busy with post-war cleanup, reconstruction aid, inspections, and traveling to sell goods, but he settled permanently in this world.
“I see… But as for Naofumi-sama now… once the Wave is over, do you think he’ll stay?”
“I’m sure he will!”
I answered cheerfully. But Big Sister-in-law’s expression didn’t brighten up.
“Is there anything I can do for Naofumi-sama? I don’t have the confidence that I can do enough to make you stay.”

I know Big Sister-in-law cares deeply for Father. And I think he feels the same way about her. After all, in the first world, Father and Big Sister were very close. I want to be like Filo-chan and Father, too!
“The Spear Hero said that Lord Naofumi would have pulled through even without me… Um, you mean when his slave mark was removed, right?”
“That’s right. Even those who’d become slaves—besides you—encouraged Father.”

Big Sister has a pensive look on her face; she’s placed her hand over her heart and closed her eyes. Could it be that I’ve been hurting her without even realizing it? Come to think of it, when Big Sister from the first world saw those scenes, she was quite flustered. So much so that she nearly knocked me flying with a hammer. It’s highly likely that my Older Sister in this world would suffer the same psychological trauma.
“I understand that myself. At that time, in that place, anyone could have encouraged Naofumi-sama… but even so, I swore to be Naofumi-sama’s support—to become his sword.”

She really shows a lot of resolve when it comes to matters like this, doesn’t she? I’m sure the Older Sister from the first world was quite concerned about it, too. And I truly respect her noble vow. After all, Father—who can only defend and has no means to attack—needs someone like her by his side.
“There’s no falsehood in this feeling. Please don’t forget that. Even if there were someone else to take my place, I have no intention of stepping aside.”
What wonderful loyalty. I’ll do my best to follow in your Older Sister’s footsteps, too.
“By the way, if Father hadn’t bought a slave, your Older Sister would have taken on that role, wouldn’t she?”

That was a tough time. After all, it was our last chance. And yet, the Crimson Swine…! Fortunately, thanks to Older Sister, we managed to pull through. I’m truly grateful to her. Just as Older Sister was about to slip and fall, she dashed out of the room.
“Sister Sadeena!”
“Sister! Where are you going!? You’re supposed to stay here and watch over Filo-tan!”
I grabbed Big Sister’s hand as she dashed out to stop her.
“Lord Naofumi has gone looking for Sister Sadeena!? Isn’t this going to be a huge problem!?”
“I think it’ll be fine. I don’t think Father from the first world—or even my Older Sister, whom I met again later—was as close to you as they were in that world.”

At my words, my Older Sister seemed to let out a burst of frustration; her face darkened as she glared at me silently. What is this? This vibe… it’s sending chills down my spine. Suddenly, a memory from long ago—when I was stabbed before coming to this world—flashes through my mind. It’s the same chill I felt when I talked to that stalker pig!
“Spear Hero… please stop messing with me. I’ll get seriously angry.”
“I’m not, I’m not joking. I’m just answering your questions with the utmost sincerity!”
“…Sigh.”
Eventually, my Older Sister looked exhausted and sat down in the chair provided.
“Let’s drop this topic. Now, I’d like to ask about what happened after the world achieved peace.”
“I’ll answer anything.”
“So, after peace was restored… what kind of life were we living?”
“We were living in the village you helped rebuild—your hometown. We spent every day happily.”
“Rebuilding the village, you say…”
The Older Sister gazed off into the distance. If my memory serves me correctly, rebuilding the village was supposed to be her dream.
“In one of the loops, when I rescued you, you had a strange smile on your face and cried intensely at night.”
“That’s… right. I’m aware of that. Thanks to you, Naofumi-sama, I was able to pull through. Will the day come when we can rebuild that village…? I think that would be wonderful.”
“I’m sure we can do it in this world, too.”
“…And you’re the one saying that? After killing that person, do you seriously think we can do it?”

My Older Sister said, furrowing her brow. I don’t know what she’s doubting, but it’s entirely possible. After all, he’s just a Crimson Swine. Once I work things out with the Queen, acquiring territory will be a piece of cake.
“Of course it will.”
“Just how carefree are you…? Fine. Let’s discuss it with Lord Naofumi and Sadeena-nee as well.”
She looked slightly happier. Despite everything, my Older Sister still holds onto her dream of rebuilding the village.
“W-well, then, I’ll go ahead and ask… Naofumi-sama and I… d-did we… get married or something?”
“I wonder? I’m pretty sure… we did.”
“Why are you being so vague about that part?”

My memories of that period are rather hazy. Since it’s been quite a while since the Wave completely ended, my memories are vague, as if shrouded in mist. I suppose you could call them fragmented? I can only recall scattered scenes from daily life, much like childhood memories, and they aren’t as clear as my memories of saving the world from the Wave. However, given the circumstances, it wouldn’t be strange if I had been married.
“Still, as the Shield Hero who saved the world, I do recall being somewhat tolerant of relationships with other women.”
“I-Is that so…”
“I seem to recall that you and your Older Sister had a child together… I’m sorry. It’s all a bit hazy.”
I can’t even remember if it was a boy or a girl. But… I do remember that the village was overflowing with happiness. Making this world like that is one of my goals.
“…No, just hearing that is enough for me. I’ll have to do my best to reach a future like that, too.”
That’s just like you, Older Sister. Before long, perhaps feeling motivated, she started doing push-ups.

Come to think of it, she was training during the party swap on Carmira Island, too. That kind of relentless effort must have been the secret to her rising to prominence as Father’s right-hand woman. She’s someone I’ve always respected. And that’s how we waited for Father to return. I got to admire Filo-tan’s sleeping face to my heart’s content. Thank you for the treat.
